narr: On the 4th/5th, a new cold front drifted into Arkansas from the north and stalled. Surrounding the front, more hit and miss thunderstorms popped up on the 5th, and produced torrential rain in places. High temperatures were in the 80s to lower 90s.||During the afternoon, precipitation was concentrated from west central into central and southeast sections of the state. The heaviest downpours were between Little Rock (Pulaski County) and Benton (Saline County), with two to more than three inch totals reported. At Crystal Valley (Pulaski County), for example, 2.75 inches of liquid was measured.
ev: Ditches were completely full and overflowing onto Maumelle Blvd/Highway 100 at the I-430 interchange. Four to six inches of water was flowing over the roadway.
